description: This file is a shell script designed for managing prplMesh processes, including starting, stopping, restarting, and rolling logs, as well as configuring parameters related to prplMesh components. It contains functions for process control, signal handling, log management, and parameter modifications, with references to specific external files and commands used to control the prplMesh environment.

methods.name: send_signal_to_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Sends a specified signal (default TERM) to a prplMesh process identified by its name.

methods.name: start_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Starts a specified prplMesh process using start-stop-daemon.

methods.name: stop_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Stops a specified prplMesh process by sending termination signals, with a timeout and fallback kill.

methods.name: roll_logs_function
methods.description: Handles rotating log files by creating locks, removing old logs, and signaling processes to roll logs.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: odl_get_str_param
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value from specified ODL files.

methods.name: odl_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in specified ODL files, handling different parameter types.

methods.name: ensure_platform_db
methods.description: Ensures the platform database file exists, copying it from shared resources if necessary.

methods.name: certification_mode_to_num
methods.description: Converts various boolean-like inputs into numeric mode values (0 or 1).

methods.name: set_management_and_certification_mode
methods.description: Configures management mode and certification mode by updating the platform database and parameters.

methods.name: start_func
methods.description: Starts the prplMesh services based on current configuration and mode.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that processes command line arguments to perform actions like start, stop, restart, status, or log rolling.
